# Method GetIsometricCamera

#### GetIsometricCamera(DocumentId)

Gets the isometric camera entity of a document.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 7, 0, 0)]
ElementId GetIsometricCamera(DocumentId inDocumentId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Identifier of the document to analyze.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  ElementId |  Identifier of the isometric camera entity found.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.7.
